Class Type

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.processing.source.Type
public final class Type extends Object
A class, interface, enum, record or annotation type, or an anonymous class. 
Type point = Type.newRecordBuilder("Point")
        .addModifiers(Modifier.PUBLIC)
        .addRecordComponent(int.class, "x")
        .addRecordComponent(int.class, "y")
        .addMethod(Method.newCompactConstructorBuilder()
                .addModifiers(Modifier.PUBLIC)
                .beginControlFlow("if (x < 0 || y < 0)")
                .addStatement("throw new $T($S)", IllegalArgumentException.class, "negative")
                .endControlFlow()
                .build())
        .build();

The member types a type inherits hide the types of the same simple name: a class implementing Map cannot name another Entry type by its simple name. Supertypes given as a TypeMirror or a Class bring the simple names of their member types along, so that such types are written qualified; for supertypes given as a TypeName, use Type.Builder.avoidClashesWithNestedClasses(TypeElement) or Type.Builder.alwaysQualify(String...).

Types are values: two types written the same, which qualify the same names, are equal.

    • newAnonymousClassBuilder

      public static Type.Builder newAnonymousClassBuilder(String format, @Nullable Object... args)
      Returns a builder of anonymous classes, written with $L in code, as in new Runnable() { ... }. It extends the superclass, or implements the one interface, it is given; Object if neither. The body of an enum constant is an anonymous class too.
      Parameters:
      format - the arguments of the superclass constructor, with placeholders; empty for none
      args - the arguments of the placeholders
      Returns:
      a new builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the format and the arguments do not match
